title: Zebra3D: Efficient Hybrid Foundation Models For Scalable 3D Reconstruction
abstract: Feed-forward 3D foundation models reconstruct scenes from unposed images, but the quadratic cost of global attention limits their scalability to large view sets. We present Zebra3D, a layerwise sparse-linear hybrid attention framework that improves the efficiency of pretrained 3D foundation models without training from scratch. Across VGGT, HunyuanWorld-Mirror, and $π^3$, we observe a broadly consistent depth-wise pattern: early stages are relatively tolerant to linear replacement, while sensitive middle-to-late stages tend to exhibit more concentrated attention. Zebra3D exploits this structure by assigning linear-centered attention to tolerant stages and tile-sparse attention to sensitive stages, using landmark summaries to preserve unselected context. Closed-form affine fitting enables training-free conversion, while optional post-conversion training combines task supervision with output and relational feature distillation. Across all three backbones, Zebra3D achieves strong reconstruction and camera-pose accuracy at high attention sparsity, with training-free variants remaining close to their dense counterparts. End-to-end speedups increase with input view count, reaching up to $7.1\times$ at 1,024 views. After post-conversion training, Zebra3D-VGGT reaches 80.5\% RealEstate10K AUC@30 at 94\% mean attention sparsity, within 1.1 percentage points of dense VGGT fine-tuned on the same data and schedule.

analysis.ideaZh: Zebra3D 先测每层linearreplacement敏感度，再把tolerant层换value-centeredlinear、敏感层留tile-softmax加landmarktail。作者报告三backbone1024views5.5-7.1倍model-forward提速，conservativepose几乎保留；这是可扩展3D架构转换而非新geometryfoundation，speed-firstPi3widebaseline明显变差，AMD单硬件/非含GSrendering成本，适合skim。
analysis.motivationZh: Feed-forward 3D reconstruction 模型的 dense cross-view attention 随视图数迅速增加成本，限制长序列和大场景输入。直接替换 attention 又可能损伤几何与相机估计，因此问题是如何复用已有模型并找到可靠的速度与精度取舍。

analysis.insightZh: 实质conversion范式为backbone-measuredlayerroles及省全权重再训练的closed-formfitting，在三模型1000view验证比单GPUkernel优化广。linear/sparse/landmarks/KD本身已有，提升主要efficientattention保近densegeometry，非新reconstructionobjective或worldmodel能力。
analysis.evidenceZh: 选择linear基于单层敏感度，不考虑同时替换交互；oracleattentionmass仅动机非实际selector。（Sec.3.1, PDF p.3; Appendix F.2 p.37）；landmark保tail但不是exactmissingcontext，selfkey已保仍留未减meanlandmark。（Eq.(6), PDF p.5; Appendix B.4 p.18）；79/94%meanattention“sparsity”不等百分比FLOPs/memory缩减。（Appendix B.11, PDF pp.22-23）；最大speedbackbone与setting不保证wide-baselineaccuracy，KD也可能退化。（Table1, PDF p.7; Table22, p.35; F.2 p.37）
analysis.caveatZh: F.2 p.37明确shortviews小收益、encoder/headbound、固定single-stagemarginalallocation忽略交互/input，AMDMI355X/Tritonportability未验证。；widebaselineAppendix E.3 pp.27-29称.7Lspeed-first主要video-likevalidated，.5L更可靠。；postconversion训练可损部分dataset；额外teacher训练成本仍存在。；geometrymain经Sim3ICP/ScanNetCDnormalized/clipped，保metric不等真实可编辑mesh/sceneobject质量。；speedup测518×378、ScanNetquality518×392，展示ratio非scene-specificrecordtimings，同配置KD/noKD复用测量。；longseqnon-stream仍sparsestageρN2加landmarkN2/B；不是线性total规模或boundedmemory。；没有assetcreation/segmentation/CAD downstream，推荐限foundationconversion技术参考。
